examples.japanese: {絨毯|じゅうたん}の{上|うえ}に{座|すわ}って{本|ほん}を{読|よ}んだ。
examples.english: I sat on the carpet and read a book.

examples.japanese: ペルシャ{絨毯|じゅうたん}は{高価|こうか}で{美|うつく}しい。
examples.english: Persian carpets are expensive and beautiful.

examples.japanese: {絨毯|じゅうたん}に{飲|の}み{物|もの}をこぼしてしまった。
examples.english: I spilled a drink on the carpet.

notes:
{絨毯|じゅうたん} refers to thick woven floor coverings, typically wall-to-wall carpets or large decorative rugs. Also commonly written in katakana as じゅうたん.

Related terms:
- カーペット (carpet - loanword, more casual)
- ラグ (smaller rug)
- マット (mat)
- {敷物|しきもの} (general term for floor coverings)

Common expressions:
- {絨毯|じゅうたん}を{敷|し}く (lay/spread a carpet)
- {絨毯|じゅうたん}を{掃除機|そうじき}で{掃除|そうじ}する (vacuum the carpet)
- {赤|あか}い{絨毯|じゅうたん} (red carpet)
